question_text: Construct replace_with_extreme_sum(stack) in Python. stack is nonempty and holds real numbers. Remove all its values and leave exactly one item:the sum of its smallest and largest original values. Use only pop, push and isEmpty.
adaptation_rationale: PreservesADT-only destructive traversal; safe initialization avoids sentinel failure.

marking_points.criterion: Initializes both extrema from an actual stack item.
Loops while stack is not empty.
Correctly updates minimum and maximum, both handling negative values.
Computes the sum of the final extrema.
Pushes exactly that sum after all original items removed.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
verification.code_check: Executable checks saved under checks/ where applicable.
